facility.name: Creative World Child Care & Preschool #2
facility.programs_provided: Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 19610 FM 362 RD, WALLER, TX, 77484

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The outdoor area had broken toys and playhouse on the playground and grass was growing through the  loose-fill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Toys and Equipment to be Sanitized Set Aside: I observed toys that were not cleaned on the shelf at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Toys and Equipment to be Sanitized Set Aside (26 TAC §746.3407(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director not have the required 30hrs of annual trainings available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: The operation did not have a playground checklist available for review during the inspection,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: The operational policy did not have procedures for inclusion.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: There were no emergency drills available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: Five out of five children files did not have a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: The operational policy was the procedures for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The children outdoor play toys were broken and could cause an unsafe environment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: One out of five children files did not have emergency contacts information on the admission sheet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies: Two out of three employee files was missing a statement stating they received the operational policy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-Proof of DFPS background checks: Two out of three personnel files did not have proof of requested background checks available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-Proof of DFPS background checks (26 TAC §746.901(7))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation did not have a current CPSC form available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: One out of three personnel files was missing an affidavit, and was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's personnel policies: Two out of three staff did not have a sign statement stating they received the personnel policy handbook in their file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's personnel policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(B))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: There was a fan excessive to the children that was not mounted away from them. This could cause an unsafe environment.    Note: This was corrected during the inspection when the director had a caregiver move the fan to the storage room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §746.3701(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: The emergency contact address was missing for 2 children records at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides: The use zone to the side of the slide was approximately 3 foot; it should extend 6 foot on both sides of the slide.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §746.4805(a))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The following items were missing from the parent handbook (operational policies provided to parents):     1. How parents can access minimum standards online  2. The phone number for the abuse neglect hotline and the HHS website  3. Abuse Neglect topics: Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of issues regardingchild abuse and neglect, including warning signs that a child may be a victim of abuse or neglect and factors indicating a child is at risk for abuse or neglect; Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of prevention techniques for child abuse and neglect;  Strategies for coordination between the center and appropriate community organizations; Actions that the parent of a child who is a victim of abuse or neglect should take to obtain assistance and intervention, including procedures for reporting child abuse or neglect.  4. Physical activity policies:  The benefits of physical activity and outdoor play; The duration of physical activity at your operation, both indoor and outdoor;   Each setting in which your physical activity program will take place;  A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Swings - in Front and Rear: The use zone for the front/back of the swings was only 9 foot to the front and 9 foot to the back; the swing height is approximately 6 foot tall.  The use zone should be 12 feet to the front and 12 feet to the back.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Swings - in Front and Rear (26 TAC §746.4807(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: A monthly checklist for November was not completed.  The following hazards were observed during the walk through: two broken cars for children to use.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))
